candidates.name: Kode CLI
candidates.reason: Exact native UUID preflight is implementable and hidden append-system-prompt-file is sound. The material released-code blocker is TUI flag wiring: --model and --permission-mode/tool restrictions are sent only to runPrintMode, not renderRepl; --settings is parsed but unused. TUI starts native yolo mode even with --safe. A full AO model/permission mapping would be false. Recommend waiting for working TUI wiring/per-session config, rather than making a misleading production registration. A narrower native-default-only terminal would have to reject these overrides and preserve explicit permission disclosures.
